name: help
description: Show the complete command catalogue and choose the workflow for the task.

name: status
description: Check the selected workspace, the installed tools and the requested org connections without printing a credential. Use it at the start of a session, after an install or upgrade, or when a command fails for an unclear reason.

name: context
description: Load the selected client's configuration, recent sessions, change records and lessons from earlier work. Use it at the start of client work and whenever the client changes.

name: new-client
description: Create a private client workspace and establish a useful engagement baseline.

name: connect-org
description: Connect an org through the Salesforce CLI or the host's integration and confirm which org the alias reaches. Use it when a client's org is not connected yet or its authorization expired.

name: diagnose
description: Find the cause of an org, tool, deployment, context or access problem and carry the authorized fix through to a check. Use it when something fails or behaves differently than expected.

name: triage-alert
description: Turn a Salesforce flow or Apex error notification into its cause, the narrowest fix, a retest and a note for the client. Use it when a fault email, an error screenshot or a user report of a failed save arrives.

name: audit-org
description: Audit an org across configuration, automation, access, data and operational health.

name: compare-orgs
description: Compare two orgs or an org and baseline to explain meaningful differences.

name: field-audit
description: Review a set of fields for how they are defined, how full they are and what uses them, and group them for cleanup or data-quality work. Use it before deleting, merging or documenting fields.

name: flow-analyzer
description: Explain, review or fix a flow from its active definition and its actual behavior. Use it when someone asks what a flow does, why it failed, or how to improve it.

name: preflight-org
description: Confirm which org an alias reaches and what the task needs from it (objects, fields, packages, current components) before live work. Use it at the start of work in an org, or when the selected client and the alias may disagree.

name: small-change
description: Make one small, everyday change end to end: a new field, a changed field or validation rule, a report, or "a user cannot see X", from the client's context to a deploy checked in the org and tested as the user. Use it for a change of a few components; larger work goes through `/requirements-to-build` and `/prep-changeset`.

name: retrieve-current
description: Retrieve the current version of the components a change touches, keep it as the baseline, and stage an editable copy. Use it before changing anything that already exists in an org.

name: prep-changeset
description: Build the deployment packet for one change: the exact components, their order, the permission set that grants each new field, the checks and the recovery references. Use it when a change is ready to go to another org.

name: gift-payments
description: Design automation that keeps an NPSP payment's date in step with its gift batch, before save where it only changes the payment. Use it when batch gift entry leaves paid payments without a payment date.

name: grants-outbound-funds
description: Build the automation that turns an approved Outbound Funds funding request into its disbursement records, without duplicates on a re-save. Use it when a grants team approves funding requests in Salesforce and wants the awards created for them.

name: prep-migration
description: Plan, rehearse and run a scoped data load or bulk change, then reconcile it and restore any setting changed for it. Use it for imports, migrations between orgs and bulk updates of existing records.

name: validate-change
description: Validate a change before it is deployed: a check-only deploy read from a file, Torque's metadata check on what that deploy would create or change, and the tests the change needs. Use it before every real deploy.

name: verify-change
description: Verify that a deployed or configured change is in the org as intended and works for the people it is for, and record what is still unchecked. Use it after every deploy or configuration change.

name: sandbox-refresh
description: Reconnect to a sandbox after it was refreshed and restore its intended settings, users and integrations from the saved baseline. Use it after a refresh has actually happened; it does not start one.

name: security-review
description: Review who can see and change which objects, fields and records against what the business process needs, and fix what is asked. Use it when users report missing or excess access, or before a change that grants access ships.

name: snapshot
description: Capture a dated baseline of the metadata, settings or records a task may change, and say what it can restore and what it only documents. Use it before a risky change, a refresh or an audit that needs a fixed point to compare against.

name: undo
description: Reverse a specific recent change from its own evidence: the recovery bundle when one exists, otherwise a scoped inverse built from the saved pre-state. Use it when the user says to undo, roll back or revert something that was done.

name: advisory
description: Use platform notes, Flow activation, impact and evidence helpers without changing the org.

name: qa
description: Choose and run the checks a change needs, from its acceptance criteria, and report each one's result and what stayed uncovered. Use it after a build or deploy, before calling a change ready.

name: qa-browser
description: Test a page or a journey in a browser as a named user, sent in through the Salesforce CLI's existing authorization, and check what it changed. Use it to see a change as its user sees it, or to run one of Torque's packaged browser journeys.

name: qa-multiprofile
description: Run the same journey as each intended user and compare what each one can see and do. Use it when access, pages or automation differ by profile, permission set or role, and before calling such a change ready.

name: qa-sanitize-replay
description: Scan a replay script for credential patterns and report masked findings.

name: qa-token-grant
description: Explain or manage an explicitly requested legacy QA skip token.

name: qa-token-show
description: Inspect an optional legacy QA skip token without affecting ordinary work.

name: qa-token-revoke
description: Remove an optional legacy QA skip token when requested.

name: revert-show
description: List available operation snapshots and their actual recovery state.

name: revert-preview
description: Preview a specific restoration against current state without executing it.

name: revert
description: Restore a supported captured operation and verify the resulting state.

name: revert-discard
description: Mark a selected snapshot abandoned while keeping its recovery artifacts.

name: lesson
description: Save, find, judge, review and promote lessons from earlier work. Use it when the consultant corrects you, when something that failed now works, and before work that earlier lessons may cover.

name: lesson-show
description: Read saved lessons: the ones that fit the work, one in full, or a list by state. Use it before work earlier lessons may cover, or when the consultant asks what Torque has learned.

name: lesson-helpful
description: Count a lesson as helpful when it saved time or prevented a mistake. Use it right after a lesson Torque showed you made a difference.

name: lesson-stale
description: Take a wrong or outdated lesson out of recall at once, with the reason, keeping its history. Use it when a lesson Torque showed you no longer holds.

name: collect-lessons
description: Review the lessons waiting for a decision and propose which to keep, retire or promote to the firm, a rule, a skill, a recipe or a check. Use it when the consultant asks, or when the context shows candidates waiting.

name: session-save
description: Save what this session did, what each check rested on and what it taught, so the next session starts from facts. Use it after meaningful client work, before a hand-off, and when the consultant corrects you.

name: session-resume
description: Pick up a client task where the last session left it: its records, the lessons that fit, and fresh checks of what may have drifted. Use it at the start of a session on work already under way.

name: export-session
description: Export selected session work as an internal record, client update or change log.

name: handoff
description: Produce a resumable handoff from the client history and current task evidence.

name: discovery
description: Carry discovery from stakeholder input to implementable requirements and an agreed next step.

name: requirements-to-build
description: Turn a stakeholder requirements note into user stories, a metadata list that starts from what the org already has, a test script and open questions. Use it when a request arrives as prose and has to become buildable work.

name: training
description: Write a practical guide for end users or administrators of a configured process, checked against the interface they actually see. Use it when a change goes live or a client asks how their staff should use it.

name: release-notes
description: Write technical and client-facing release notes from the evidence of what was actually deployed and verified. Use it when a set of changes is released or handed to a client.

name: process-meeting
description: Extract a recording timeline and turn supplied meeting material into decisions and delivery work.

name: logs
description: Analyze Salesforce debug logs and relate what they show to the reported problem. Use it when an error, a slow transaction or an automation path needs evidence from a log.

name: probes
description: Generate editable Apex test drafts (null and empty inputs for each public method) from class files, then turn them into real tests. Use it when Apex needs edge-case tests written quickly.

name: update-torque
description: Update the Torque installation, then carry its new recipes, rules and skills into the private workspace while keeping local edits. Use it when a new Torque release is out or the consultant asks to update.

name: update-jsc
description: Continue the old update command name through the Torque update workflow.
